   220  static void
   221  source_init_source( j_decompress_ptr cinfo )
   222  {
   223          Source *src = (Source *) cinfo->src;
   224
   225          /* Start off empty ... libjpeg will call fill_input_buffer to get the
   226           * first bytes.
   227           */
   228          src->pub.next_input_byte = src->buf;
   229          src->pub.bytes_in_buffer = 0;
   230  }
   231
   232  /* Fill the input buffer --- called whenever buffer is emptied.
   233   */
   234  static boolean
   235  source_fill_input_buffer( j_decompress_ptr cinfo )
   236  {
   237          static const JOCTET eoi_buffer[4] = {
   238                  (JOCTET) 0xFF, (JOCTET) JPEG_EOI, 0, 0
   239          };
   240
   241          Source *src = (Source *) cinfo->src;
   242
   243          size_t read;
   244
   245          if( (read = vips_source_read( src->source,
   246                  src->buf, SOURCE_BUFFER_SIZE )) > 0 ) {
   247                  src->pub.next_input_byte = src->buf;
   248                  src->pub.bytes_in_buffer = read;
   249          }
   250          else {
   251                  WARNMS( cinfo, JWRN_JPEG_EOF );
   252                  src->pub.next_input_byte = eoi_buffer;
   253                  src->pub.bytes_in_buffer = 2;
   254          }
   255
   256          return( TRUE );
   257  }
